title: Good machine configuration
statement: For natural numbers $C,e,B$, a Boolean mode, a Boolean-list input $h$, and a configuration $a$ of the machine with $14$ registers, call $a$ good when it is a pre-configuration for the specified machine on input $h$ and every register value in $a$ is at most $B$.
caveat: The pre-configuration predicate and configuration structure are referenced but not informally defined in the supplied statement.
